body:
Can the official Repo2RLEnv pipeline feed portable exports into independent validation without per-repository edits or extra LLM repairs? Subissue of #33; validation component: [PR #46](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/pull/46), open/unmerged.

**Result:** fresh official Cobrapy generation produced one export for known PR #1497, using 11 built-in upstream calls at provider actual **$0.287646**. The automatic connector verified its archive/cleanup, ran the unchanged local exporter and launched ordinary independent validation. Clean reconstruction failed before either control: the native prelude deletes APT indexes, then the saved recipe installs `libexpat1-dev` without refreshing them. No independent reward or positive pair exists. [Source-bound findings](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/7759bb06/experiments/45-generation-handoff/results.md).

**Evidence:** original task/grading/settings remain unchanged; no regeneration or task/package/parser repairs. Generation and validator primary archives passed anonymous HF readback. Generation cleanup is verified; validator cleanup is finishing. All 35 generation/connector checks pass; twelve historical exports also pass local preparation/planning. These checks do not establish fresh native success.

**Limits/next:** this known-PR integration reference is not unbiased yield or a new unique task. Bootstrap smoke/fresh flags were false despite upstream export; original pre/post suites took over 430 seconds, exceeding the exported 300-second verifier limit. That prospective timeout is separate from the observed pre-control APT failure. Investigate general recipe fidelity separately and retain this failed official baseline unchanged. Keep issue/epic open for review; detailed logs and HF receipts are in comments.

**Budget:** epic provider actual $0.287646, existing $10 storage reservation unreconciled, no active model reservation or further model admission. CPU accounting/cleanup remain governed by #33’s cumulative 32 CPUh and $90 operating ceiling, strictly below $100 extra. No new capacity or automatic dataset release.
